-- Number of set bits in a byte.
bit_count(x: u8) -> int =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= 8
  ex bit_count(0) == 0
  ex bit_count(255) == 8
  var n = x
  var c = 0
  for i in range(0, 8)
    if n % 2 == 1
      c += 1
    n = n // 2
  c

-- True when the byte has an odd number of set bits.
parity(x: u8) -> bool =
  post out == (bit_count(x) % 2 == 1)
  ex parity(0) == False
  ex parity(1) == True
  ex parity(3) == False
  bit_count(x) % 2 == 1
